rules: Real expert work, not simple questions and answers
Clear value to a business or a field
Hard enough that today's best models fail
Clear inputs, expected output and goal
A checkable answer, plus the steps to reach it
Scored step by step, not only at the end
A scoring rubric with 30+ weighted items
